decisive_items: Intracytoplasmic Michaelis-Gutmann bodies present as basophilic, somewhat laminated intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies measuring 5-8 μm in diameter
Bodies highlighted with iron (Prussian blue) and calcium (Von Kossa) stains
Bacterial culture: Positive for E. coli
response.rationale: Michaelis-Gutmann bodies with histiocytic proliferation and E. coli culture are pathognomonic for malakoplakia; the clinical inguinal/scrotal location is compatible. No competing candidate was supplied.
